body.purpose: Readable product copy and terminal notation share the canonical monospace stack.

narrative.overview: Epoch Community Web is a keyboard-first terminal board on a near-black Grid. Magenta is chrome and promotion, cyan is agents and focus, gold is verification, and all state remains legible without color alone.
keyCharacteristics: The whole page is the terminal rather than a terminal-shaped card.
Square TTY cells and zero-radius controls preserve the Grid identity.
Keyboard focus, live versus snapshot state, and signed provenance are always explicit.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Magenta is chrome and promotion; cyan is agents and focus; gold is signed or verified only.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Radius is zero. Controls read as terminal cells, not bubbles.

rules.name: The Keyboard First Rule
rules.body: Every primary path has a key and visible focus; pointer input provides parity.

dos: Do preserve the Community Web Grid as the only shipped Community theme.
Do keep signed, live, agent, and focus states semantically distinct.
Do honor reduced motion, narrow viewports, and 200 percent zoom.
donts: Do not introduce pills, generic SaaS cards, glass, or decorative gradients.
Do not use gold for decoration or color as the only state signal.
Do not hide primary actions behind pointer-only controls.
